task_summary: Architected and integrated the Committee Secretary defense workflow into CMS-V2 and connected it to the Action Done Matrix (ADM). Implemented Live Defense Minutes logging with category tagging, score aggregation with 75% threshold validation, consensus verdict recording with chair sign-off, live socket room broadcasting, and enforced a strict Secretary Compliance Verification Endorsement Gate before Tier 1/2/3 committee digital signatures can unlock.

architectural_changes.description: Defined and exported SECRETARY_CAPABILITIES and SECRETARY_CAPABILITY_VALUES for fine-grained capability checks.

Created defense minutes Mongoose model and service for live critique entries, score aggregation, and ADM publishing. Added Secretary Endorsement Gate in Project model and signTieredADM authorization. Added emitToRoom socket support.

Built interactive Live Defense Minutes Modal with real-time logging, score aggregator, and consensus verdict. Added Secretary Compliance Verification Gate before Tier 1 in ActionDoneMatrixTab, locking committee signatures until endorsed.
